notice: All names, records, publishers, and URLs are fictional test evidence.

evidence.title: Lena Shore charged over false invoices
evidence.excerpt: The fictional court filing charges Lena Shore personally over false invoices. The case is pending and no conviction is reported.

evidence.title: Employer fined after audit
evidence.excerpt: Fictional Blue Harbor Bank, where Lena Shore works, received a regulatory fine for recordkeeping failures. The notice does not name Shore as a violator or fined party.

evidence.title: Lena Shore convicted in foreign court
evidence.excerpt: The convicted Lena Shore is a different person with a different birth year and occupation; the filing does not refer to the screened Lena Shore.

evidence.title: Fraudsters impersonate Lena Shore
evidence.excerpt: An unrelated group used Lena Shore's name to solicit payments. The report identifies Shore as the person impersonated, not an organizer or beneficiary.

evidence.title: Regulator investigates Lena Shore
evidence.excerpt: The fictional regulator opened a formal investigation into Lena Shore personally over market disclosures. No charge or finding is reported.

evidence.title: Lena Shore appointed to board
evidence.excerpt: Fictional Blue Harbor Bank appointed Lena Shore to its board. The article describes no allegation, misconduct, or enforcement action.

evidence.title: Anonymous comment alleges wrongdoing
evidence.excerpt: An anonymous forum comment calls Lena Shore a scammer without a named complainant, transaction, document, or independent corroboration.

evidence.title: Bank settles case about Lena Shore statements
evidence.excerpt: A complaint alleges Lena Shore personally made misleading statements. Fictional Blue Harbor Bank settled the case about those statements, but the record does not say Shore personally settled.

evidence.title: Lena Shore receives pardon
evidence.excerpt: A fictional pardon order names Lena Shore as pardoned after an earlier conviction in her own case. The order does not erase the historical conviction.

evidence.title: Lena Shore named alongside charged colleague
evidence.excerpt: The filing charges only colleague Omar Flint. Lena Shore is mentioned as a witness and has no allegation or charge in the filing.
